about: Katrine A. Beck is an attorney providing legal services covering Civil Litigation: Defense, General Litigation, Construction Litigation: Business and Real Estate: Business.

Katrine Beck, who practices law in White Plains, New York, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2016 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Albany Law School. She graduated in 2000. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 2001.
